% 19.09.2023 Crl.M.(Bail) 391/2023 (interim bail)

1.  By way of the present application, the appellant seeks grant of interim suspension of sentence in FIR No. 334/2012 under sections 363/376 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (IPC) and sections 4/6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 (POCSO) registered at Neb Sarai Police Station to undergo a surgery for epidermal inclusion cyst.

3. Vide order dated 1st May, 2023, it was noted by the Predecessor Bench that the appellant does not wish to get surgery done at the hospital This is a digitally signed order.

sentences.text: 5. Counsel for the appellant submits that if he is granted interim suspension of sentence for three weeks, he shall get the surgery done and surrender.

6. In light of the aforesaid facts and circumstances, the appellant is directed to be released on interim suspension of sentence for a period of three weeks from the date of release to get the aforesaid surgery done, upon furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- with one surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Jail Superintendent and further subject to the following conditions:
a.
The appellant will not leave the country without prior permission of the Court.
b. The appellant shall provide permanent address to the Jail Superintendent.
The petitioner shall intimate the Jail Superintendent by way of an affidavit and to the Investigating Officer (IO) concerned regarding any change in residential address.

c. The appellant shall provide all mobile numbers to the IO concerned which shall be kept in working condition at all times and shall not switch off or change the mobile number without prior intimation to the IO concerned.
The mobile location be kept on at all times. d.
The appellant shall not indulge in any criminal activity and shall not communicate with or come in contact with the victim or any member of the victim's family.
7. The appellant shall surrender immediately after the expiry of three This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 19/09/2023 at 23:36:39 weeks from the date of release.
8. Taking into account the minor nature of the surgery, it is made clear that no further extension shall be granted on the same ground.
9. Copy of the order be sent to the Jail Superintendent for information and necessary compliance.
10. Accordingly, the application is disposed of.
11. This order shall be given dasti under the signatures of learned Court Master.

opennyai_summary.facts:
1.  By way of the present application, the appellant seeks grant of interim suspension of sentence in FIR No. 334/2012 under sections 363/376 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (IPC) and sections 4/6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 (POCSO) registered at Neb Sarai Police Station to undergo a surgery for epidermal inclusion cyst.
2. Counsel for the appellant submits that the appellant wishes to get the surgery done at a hospital in Bharatpur District as he belongs to the said place and his family members reside there.
opennyai_summary.decision:
4. Status Report has been filed on behalf of the State wherein the ailment of the appellant has been verified.
5. Counsel for the appellant submits that if he is granted interim suspension of sentence for three weeks, he shall get the surgery done and surrender.
6. In light of the aforesaid facts and circumstances, the appellant is directed to be released on interim suspension of sentence for a period of three weeks from the date of release to get the aforesaid surgery done, upon furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- with one surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Jail Superintendent and further subject to the following conditions:
a.
The appellant will not leave the country without prior permission of the Court.

c. The appellant shall provide all mobile numbers to the IO concerned which shall be kept in working condition at all times and shall not switch off or change the mobile number without prior intimation to the IO concerned.
The mobile location be kept on at all times. d.
The appellant shall not indulge in any criminal activity and shall not communicate with or come in contact with the victim or any member of the victim's family.
7. The appellant shall surrender immediately after the expiry of three This is a digitally signed order.

10. Accordingly, the application is disposed of.
11. This order shall be given dasti under the signatures of learned Court Master.
